title: What my Harvest spec forgot: 21/21 checks passed, 21 gaps found #shorts
description:
Claude built a Harvest alternative, a weekly timesheet app, from one written spec: all 21 acceptance checks passed in a real browser, and the build still exposed 21 gaps in the spec. The one I didn't see coming: sign-in was limited to our company email, but no setting held the email domain. All 21 gaps are now fixed in the spec.

What the build test did not cover: production sign-in, real email delivery, the hourly job on a real scheduler, and hosting.

Full build test (2:48): https://youtu.be/Z2wrf7ZLiQ4
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/timesheets
Harvest pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/harvest

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera intro and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
